explanation: The `\bibliographystyle{nosuchstyle}` line names a style file, `nosuchstyle.bst`, that is neither in the project folder nor in this TeX installation, so BibTeX could not format the bibliography and it will be empty. Check the spelling against a style you know exists (`plain`, `unsrt`, `alpha` and `abbrv` come with every installation), or put the `.bst` file the journal gave you next to your `.tex` files.
rawMessage: I couldn't open style file nosuchstyle.bst
title: `nosuchstyle` is not a bibliography style BibTeX can find
